status: runtime-integrated evidence extension; not a survey, not current-age, not 1:1

heightUnits.statement: The layer metadata states the unit explicitly: sourceHeightModelInfo = gravity_related_height, vertCRS NAVD88_height_(ftUS), heightUnit us-foot (consistent with VCS 105703/6360). MAX_HEIGHT = ELEVATION - BASE_ELEVATION holds for every record, so MAX_HEIGHT is a height difference in US survey feet. metres = ft * 1200/3937.

transforms.note: LiDAR horizontal calibration shift (~0.2 m, ~1.1 m) is NOT applied to this DEM (4 m grid).

terrain.grid: 4 m nodes x in {-1570,-1568..-760}, z in {-510,-508..568,570}; zipper strip x[-764,-760] onto the old 8 m seam
terrain.source: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM, bilinear sample at nodes, minus 165

seam.blend: derived smoothstep transition over 48.0 m west of x=-760 (not measured terrain)

buildings.heightRule: top = min baked ground under footprint boundary + MAX_HEIGHT (ft->m). BASE_ELEVATION is not used as an absolute because it differs from the DEM (see baseElevationMinusBakedGround).

surfaces.rule: clip to owned union, remove included building footprints (courtyard holes kept), per-record difference against higher-priority/earlier records, split only on intersecting terrain triangles (STRtree), constrained Delaunay, y = terrain plane + 0.04 m, fading linearly to 0 over x[-764,-760] so surfaces meet the old seam flush

stage2.why: stage 1 never draped City parking, driveways or patios (its filtered input lacked those kinds); they rendered as lawn
stage2.rule: stage-1 rule on the shipped terrain: clip to union, minus included footprints and all stage-1 surfaces, per-record difference in priority order (driveway, patio, parking), slivers < 0.3 m opened away, split on intersecting terrain triangles, constrained Delaunay, y = terrain plane + drape fading to 0 over the seam strip
stage2.notDraped: Median, Uncovered/Covered Deck, pools, Recreation Court/Ball Field, unpaved kinds, Miscellaneous stay lawn
